metadata.description: Fan-out/fan-in orchestration for Claude Code — independent subagent sampling with recurrence-ranked synthesis, and recon-gated investigation fan-out with disk-backed findings.

plugins.name: stochastic-consensus
plugins.description: Two fan-out/fan-in orchestration skills for Claude Code. stochastic-consensus samples one question across many independent agents and ranks ideas by how often they recurred. fanout-investigation splits a large body of material across many agents, keeps their findings on disk, and reduces them through layered synthesis with a coverage audit.
